description: Joy Hohn of rural Hartford, won the Republican primary for South Dakota Senate, serving Minnehaha County District 9, including northwestern Sioux Falls, Hartford and Wall Lake.“I am incredibly humbled and honored to have been elected by the people of District 9,” said Senator elect Joy A. Hohn. “I appreciate the confidence of the voters and will work hard to do my very best to serve them with integrity, bring their voice and represent their interests in Pierre.

title: Joy Hohn Wins Senate Republican Primary - Joy Hohn for South Dakota Senate District 9
